What's New

  • 🦜 Updated Parakeet model (delete and re-download the model)
  • ☁️ Added AssemblyAI and Cartesia transcription models
  • 📝 Added transcription formatting controls
  • 📊 Stats are now stored separately from transcript history
  • 🎙️ Improved recording startup reliability
  • 🍎 Fixed Apple Speech issue
  • 🐛 Minor fixes and improvements
  • All fork features preserved (Qwen3-ASR, WhisperMLX, WhisperCoreML, Chinese Post-Processing, Edit Mode)
